name: the-network
description: Learn about the apps powered by The Network and sign yourself up.

interface.shortDescription: Find out what The Network's apps do and how to join
interface.longDescription: Explains The Network, peon.biz (work and hiring) and friends.help (friends in NYC, SF, LA, Chicago and Miami): who can join, how introductions and privacy work, and how to stop. It helps you write your profile in this conversation and shows it to you for approval. You confirm your own phone and choose to allow access in your own browser. Then it sends the profile that you approved, and it can show your own status, your saved profile and your updates in that app. It never asks for your phone number or your verification code.
defaultPrompt: What is The Network and how do I join?
